name: HR-MMF 5-year global climate simulations (0 K control and +4 K warmed)
model_or_instrument: E3SM-MMF (HR-MMF configuration with embedded 2D SAM CRM)
resolution: Host GCM ne30pg2 (~1.5°), CRM Δx = 200 m (256 columns, 51.2 km domain), L125 vertical levels (concentrated Δz = 20 m)

scales.note: E3SM-MMF configuration with embedded 2D CRM (dx=200 m, 51.2 km domain, dt=2 s) within ~1.5 degree (ne30pg2) global GCM; two 5-year runs analyzed using monthly and 5-year means.
